The '''Biivren system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Biivren sector/Legends|Biivren sector]], within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Biivren]].
